description: Feature which has a point geometry and represents the locations where pedestrians and / or vehicles can enter or exit a site.

osid.description: Primary identifier for the feature. The OSID is a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) and requires no centralised authority to ensure uniqueness. Note that the same OSID can occur in more than one feature type when a single feature is represented multiple times in the OS NGD.

toid.description: Topographic identifier (TOID) of the feature, as published in the OS MasterMap suite of products.

versiondate.description: Date when the version was last updated.

versionavailablefromdate.description: The date this version of the feature became the latest version.

versionavailabletodate.description: The date this version of the feature was superseded by an update or ceased to exist.

changetype.description: The type of change that generated a new version of the feature.
enum: Moved From A Different Feature Type
Moved To A Different Feature Type

geometry_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example the date of collection by a surveyor or third party information received.

geometry_capturemethod.description: The source organisation who provided the data.

geometry_updatedate.description: Date when the attribute was last updated.

theme.description: The OS NGD Theme to which the feature belongs. Multiplicity allows for a primary theme to be assigned along with additional themes. For example, a Verge is primarily in the OS NGD Transport Theme, but it is also in the OS NGD Land Theme.

description.description: A single descriptive value intended for a quick understanding of what the feature represents.

access_mode.description: A description of the method(s) of access normally utilised at the Site Access Location (for example, Pedestrian).

access_purpose.description: A description of the principal access function at the Site Access Location (for example, Private or Public).

access_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example, the date of collection by a surveyor or third party information received.

access_updatedate.description: Date when the attribute was last updated.

accessedsiteid.description: The unique identifier (OSID) of the site feature to which the SiteAccessLocation feature relates.

accessednetworknodefeaturetype.description: The OS NGD network that the feature is accessed from (for example, Road Network).

accessednetworknodeid.description: The unique identifier (OSID) of the network node that represents the point on that network that provides access to the Site Access Location feature.

distancetonetworknode_m.description: The straight line measure between the accessednetworknodeid and the location of the access feature.
